main_measure.name: OLS slope of 5-bar forward return minus coin drift on forecast, non-overlapping grid, pooled
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms, t <= -2 rejects, over at least 1000 grid cases

supporting_check.name: timing gain before costs (mean daily position gain minus gain from coin mean drift)

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more over at least 1000 grid cases and the timing gain is positive.
reading: All grid bars (positions 0,5,10,... of each window with a full 5-bar return, flat forecasts included) enter an ordinary least-squares slope with intercept, the drift is the coin's mean grid 5-bar return over all windows, and the book before costs is the previous bar's allocation times the coin's daily return, averaged over coins per day.
